input: path to the current Interaction's Workspace output/ directory
native_semantics: Adapt only /root/output, /logs/verifier, and fixed HTTP port; execute the complete materialized upstream Playwright/pytest suite.
security: Submission JavaScript executes in local Chromium; explicit unsafe opt-in is mandatory and this is not a container Sandbox.
invocation: Send one JSON request on stdin; read one JSON result from stdout.
python_requirements: pytest + Playwright/Chromium as declared by the source benchmark
